semantic.justification: Original invariantChars bit masks and counted/NUL-terminated UTF16 predicate are retained, with all65536 code units checked by the existing Olson native witness. The counted ASCII-platform u_UCharsToChars release path now preserves source NUL substitution for non-invariant units; the key/type witness independently matches all65536 conversion outputs. Native debug assertions, EBCDIC, remaining conversion APIs, general UnicodeString extraction/FixedString allocation, ABI and full locale/calendar service integration remain uncertified or pending.
